correctness.rationale: At each modulus m=22 or 27, primitive residue pairs modulo unit scaling form exactly 36 free orbits. L(a,b)=(a,a+b) and R(a,b)=(a+b,b) are well-defined on orbits and realize the exact two-child Stern recursion on the shell [2^k,2^(k+1)). An independently written exact-integer BFS enumerated all primitive orbits for both moduli and their transition systems. It reproduced matching shell counts for the first 72 k, independently matched direct raw Stern values through k=13, and checked the 36 consecutive k=12..47 residuals for both moduli for c=(1,-3,4,-6,9,-13,14,-18,12,-16,0,32,-64). The residual sequence itself is a linear output of the 36-dimensional transfer matrix and satisfies its characteristic recurrence, hence 36 consecutive zeros force all zeros by Cayley–Hamilton. The first 12 equal coefficients plus the shared order-12 recurrence imply equal shell counts for all k. Equivalently 72 initial zeros for a block-diagonal 72-dimensional difference output imply equality for all k. Numerator terms (0,...,0,4,-4,8,-16,32) and claimed rational denominator independently recomputed. With s(0)=0, T(2^r;m)=1+sum_{k<r}Z_m(k), including r=0. The finite computation is combined with valid finite-to-infinite linear algebra, not mistaken for an infinite experiment.

evidence: For all r, T(2^r;m)=1+sum_{k=0}^{r-1}Z_m(k); first differences convert equality for all powers into Z_22(k)=Z_27(k) for all k.
The original 2006 preprint page 3 and the 2008 journal page 3 mark precisely this cumulative equality as conjectural, checked through r<=19.
The attached 36-state proof and independent check give matching shell counts, so the cumulative equality follows including r=0.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Difference of the cumulative counts at consecutive powers is exactly a dyadic-shell count; the two formulations are equivalent. The common exact rational shell series/order-12 recurrence is an additional reusable structural description of modular Stern distribution. Exact computational certification is mathematically meaningful because the states and recurrence derive from the Stern recursion and Cayley–Hamilton. Scope limited to this pair, not a general modulus-pair classification.
